_about: The baseline tools/fight/balance_audit.py compares each character with. baseline: median (the roster's medians, the default) or fixed (the numbers under fixed). tolerance: how far a character may differ before it is listed (damage, life, attack, defence: fractions; advantage_hit, advantage_guard, startup_light: frames). classes: the buttons of light / medium / heavy normals. intentional: CHARACTER:STATE pairs (or a character name) whose likely mistakes were looked at and kept on purpose: they are listed as character traits instead.
